newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish new car registrations rose 35 pct Nov - SCB.
newsitem.headline: Swedish new car registrations rose 35 pct Nov - SCB.

text.p: New car registrations rose 35 percent in November to 21,173, Sweden's official statistics bureau Statistics Sweden (SCB) said on Monday.
Total registrations so far this year rose 13 percent to 181,198 cars compared to the first 11 months of 1995, SCB said.
New truck registrations rose 31.9 percent to 1,904 compared with November 1995, SCB said.
Industry organisation AB Bilstatistik said earlier on Monday new car registrations rose 26 percent in November to 19,147, or seven percent to 166,227 in the first 11 months of 1996.
